scenes.text: Can't get a waiter's attention in Korea? Say this.
It means: over here! In Korea, calling out is polite. Nobody comes to your table by themselves.
Say it to order, to get more side dishes, or when you're ready to pay. If there's a bell on the table, press it.
scenes.label: Use it

caption:
Waiting forever for a waiter in Korea? Say this 🙋
여기요! (yeo-gi-yo) = over here! Calling out is normal and polite. If there's a bell on the table, press it instead.
